notebooks.title: 滑台：实际力、状态、读数与接触边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
m = 2.0
uc = 3.0
umax = 2.0
q0, v0, bias = 0.0, 0.2, 0.01
t = np.linspace(0, 1, 101)
u = np.clip(uc, -umax, umax)
a = u / m
q = q0 + v0*t + 0.5*a*t*t
v = v0 + a*t

cells.code:
print('force_acceleration', u, a)
print('end_q_v_y', round(q[-1], 8), round(v[-1], 8), round(q[-1]+bias, 8))
print('same_position_different_velocity', 0.2*1, -0.2*1)
print('exercise3_q_v', 0.5*1*1, 1*1)
assert np.allclose([q[-1], v[-1], q[-1]+bias], [0.7, 1.2, 0.71])

stop = 0.5
hit = (-v0 + np.sqrt(v0*v0 + 2*a*stop))/a
print('first_stop_time_s', round(hit, 8))
print('free_model_at_1s_m', round(q[-1], 8), 'stop_m', stop)
print('zero_force_position_at_1s_m', v0)
assert abs(hit - 0.819803902718557) < 1e-12
